description_en: Releases a pay-as-you-go Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance or an expired subscription instance
description_zh: 释放Web应用防火墙（WAF）按量付费实例或者到期的包年包月实例
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi delete-instance --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group.

Default value: empty, which indicates the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
相关的资源组ID。

默认为空，表示属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generated for this API request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为此次API调用请求生成的唯一标识符
